title: The design holds
question: Do the design's rules hold at every size: equal buttons stay equal, a centered title stays centered, items in a list share one left edge?

title: Large text
question: Does the layout hold at every system text size, from 100% to the largest accessibility size?

title: Images keep their shape
question: Can an image ever be stretched or squashed out of its aspect ratio?

title: Images stay sharp
question: Can an image ever be drawn larger than its native size, so it looks blurry?

title: Above the keyboard
question: With the on-screen keyboard open at any height, do the field being typed in and its button stay visible above it?

title: Labels are never cut off
question: Can a label that must be read in full, such as a form label, a price or a button, ever get cut off, at any screen size and any label up to its stated length?

title: Nothing moves when content loads
question: Can content that loads later, such as a photo, an ad or a banner, push what the user is about to tap or read?

title: Lines stay readable
question: Do text columns stay readable: never squeezed below about 15 characters, never stretched past about 80?

title: Nothing sticks out
question: Can any element stick out of its parent, or overlap its neighbour, at any screen size and text length?

title: Nothing jumps
question: Does anything jump when the window is resized a little, or move the wrong way when a text gets longer?

title: Clear of the notch
question: Do buttons and text stay clear of the notch, the status bar and the home indicator, for any size of them?

title: Big enough to tap
question: Can any button get smaller than 44 × 44 px, Apple's minimum tap target, or end up closer than 8 px to its neighbour?

title: Longer translations
question: Does the layout hold when every label is up to 1.5 times as long as in English, as in German or Finnish?
